question: A schematic robot initially faces right. What minimum absolute rotation angle is needed to face down in case A, or left in case B? Answer A/B in degrees.
convention: Shortest in-place change of heading, report unsigned angle in degrees. Either rotation direction may be used; do not infer time or energy.
motivation: A heading-change event count does not specify how large the turn is. The existing path descriptor excludes initial alignment; this separate conceptual task explicitly introduces an initial heading. No existing metric semantics or code is changed yet.
scope: AI-framed schematic orientation exercise, not physical motion, collision feasibility, constant angular speed, turn-duration measurement or completed orientation-aware planning.
